headline: India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigns amid NEET paper leak protests
summary: The resignation follows weeks of nationwide protests over allegations of question paper leaks in the NEET medical entrance exam.
details: India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned on Saturday, July 25, following weeks of widespread protests across the country.
caption:

headline: Brazil national team could be heading to Kolkata for friendly in October
summary: The CBF is in advanced talks with Indian organisers to bring the five-time world champions to the subcontinent in early October.
details: The Brazil national football team is in advanced negotiations to play an international friendly in Kolkata in early October, according to reports from ESPN Brasil and Estadao.
The Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) is reportedly finalizing contractual details with Indian organisers, though the opponent for the match has not yet been confirmed.
Talks were triggered by viral videos of thousands of supporters in India and Bangladesh wearing Brazil jerseys and celebrating, which caught the attention of the क्योंकि CBF.
The proposed match in Kolkata would be part of a three-game itinerary during the FIFA international window from September 21 to October 6, following two confirmed matches against Australia.
While there were discussions regarding matches in Bangladesh, Singapore, and Qatar, negotiations have only progressed with India at this stage.
The CBF decided against a fourth game to prioritize player recovery and travel concerns, limiting the itinerary to three matches.
A match in Kolkata would revive the city's historic link with Brazilian football, echoing Pele's famous 1977 appearance at Eden Gardens.
caption:
The Selecao are coming! Brazil is in advanced talks to play a historic friendly in Kolkata this October.

The Brazil national football team is in advanced negotiations to play an international friendly in Kolkata in early October, according to reports from ESPN Brasil and Estadao.

The Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) is reportedly finalizing contractual details with Indian organisers, though the opponent for the match has not yet been confirmed.

Talks were triggered by viral videos of thousands of supporters in India and Bangladesh wearing Brazil jerseys and celebrating, which caught the attention of the क्योंकि CBF.

The proposed match in Kolkata would be part of a three-game itinerary during the FIFA international window from September 21 to October 6, following two confirmed matches against Australia.

While there were discussions regarding matches in Bangladesh, Singapore, and Qatar, negotiations have only progressed with India at this stage.

The CBF decided against a fourth game to prioritize player recovery and travel concerns, limiting the itinerary to three matches.

A match in Kolkata would revive the city's historic link with Brazilian football, echoing Pele's famous 1977 appearance at Eden Gardens.
